posts.title: VFV Mobile
posts.description: What happens when you wrap a van in a map? The LWAP poster "All the sailing in a single map" has finally dressed the company vehicle of the rightful owner of the VFV brand: Vuoi Fare Vela , with a great result in terms of design, graphic impact, and coordinated communication. You will run into the van on the road across Italy, following technical and sailing support for the O'Pen Skiff regattas.

posts.description: Concept Label: Farnulla Wines – Vermentino Farnulla Wines is dedicated to producing high-quality wines with a minimal ecological footprint. By blending the " winemaker’s ingenuity with renewable technologies to power production—and strictly avoiding synthetic chemicals—we create wines that honor the earth". The Spirit of the Wine This Vermentino is crafted to be low-alcohol and exceptionally crisp

posts.title: Stealing a 5th-century anemoscope
posts.description: During my visit to the Celio Archaeological Museum in Rome , I was impressed by this Roman artifact from the 5th century AD. And I stole it. It's a stone disk with 16 faces carved on a pedestal, measuring approximately 60 x 150 cm. It was used to indicate wind directions, and as a good navigator, I was fascinated.
